prompt:
Photograph of a sturdy English merchant ship of about 1620 with a broad,
deep hull, a raised wooden stern two decks high, its poop and
quarterdeck planked like the rest of the hull, and a smaller raised bow
deck: square course and topsail on the fore and main masts, a lateen
sail on the mizzen, a square spritsail under the steeply raked bowsprit,
weathered buff and black paint, simple trim and a few small gun ports,
under sail at sea, seen from low over the water, her bow to the left and
a little towards us, a blue sea with white crests and the open sea
running to the horizon all round her and a sky of soft even blue with a
few white clouds, a natural photograph with no frame, no border and no
circle. Historical reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic. The
whole ship is built of planked wood: no tower, nothing of stone.
